scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run generate:prisma && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:watch --workspace=shared" "npm run test:watch --workspace=server" "npm run test:watch --workspace=client"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=shared && npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=client
